name: zsnd_group_load_config_block
description: zSndGroup_LoadConfigBlock recursively loads one sound-group config block, including delay, play-count, weight, stream name, and optional nested child blocks.
known_limits: VC5SP3 byte verification was attempted before the direct parser source-shape cleanup with vc5_o2_ob0_facs, vc5_o2_ob1_facs, vc5_o2_ob1_gx_facs, vc5_o2_ob2_facs, vc5_o2_ob2_gx_facs, and vc5_o2_ob1_md_gx_facs; the closest profiles were vc5_o2_ob2_facs and vc5_o2_ob2_gx_facs with 533 unmasked mismatches. Rerun VC5 before using this as tier S evidence.
The former local ArrayBase/ArrayCount, StorePlayCount, and ReportConfigError helper delegation was removed; the source now emits direct node-array walks, play-count stores, and zError call sites.
Binary Ninja reconstruction remains limited around inline string compares rendered with unimplemented sbb flag IL and some zReader node-array pointer displays.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4a49b0 seeds maxPlayCount to 65535 when unset, mirrors maxPlayCount into currentPlayCount, walks child zReader nodes, recursively loads nested array children, stores DELAY_PLAY, PLAY_COUNT, WEIGHT, stream name, and optional child blocks, and reports type errors through zError::ReportOldNoOp.

The native config-block smoke verifies delay storage, PLAY_COUNT float rounding into max/current play counts, WEIGHT float storage, stream-name capture, nested child allocation/loading, and default child max/current play counts.
